verses.original: δὲ Περὶ τῶν πνευματικῶν ἀδελφοί οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν
verses.transliteration: de Peri tōn pneumatikōn adelphoi ou thelō hymas agnoein
verses.literal: Now about - spiritual [gifts] brothers vvv I do not want you to be uninformed

verses.original: Οἴδατε ὅτι ὅτε ἦτε ἔθνη ὡς ἂν ἤγεσθε ἀπαγόμενοι πρὸς τὰ τὰ ἄφωνα εἴδωλα
verses.transliteration: Oidate hoti hote ēte ethnē hōs an ēgesthe apagomenoi pros ta ta aphōna eidōla
verses.literal: You know that when you were pagans vvv vvv you were influenced [and] led astray to - - mute idols

verses.original: διὸ γνωρίζω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς λαλῶν ἐν Πνεύματι Θεοῦ λέγει ΙΗΣΟΥΣ Αναθεμα καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται εἰπεῖν ΙΗΣΟΥΣ Κυριος εἰ μὴ ἐν Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: dio gnōrizō hymin hoti oudeis lalōn en Pneumati Theou legei IĒSOUS Anathema kai oudeis dynatai eipein IĒSOUS Kyrios ei mē en Hagiō Pneumati
verses.literal: Therefore I inform you that no one who is speaking by [the] Spirit of God says Jesus [be] cursed and no one can say Jesus [is] Lord except . . . by [the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: δὲ εἰσίν Διαιρέσεις χαρισμάτων δὲ τὸ αὐτὸ Πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: de eisin Diaireseis charismatōn de to auto Pneuma
verses.literal: - There are different gifts but the same Spirit

verses.original: καὶ εἰσιν διαιρέσεις διακονιῶν καὶ ὁ αὐτὸς Κύριος
verses.transliteration: kai eisin diaireseis diakoniōn kai ho autos Kyrios
verses.literal: - There are different ministries but the same Lord

verses.original: καὶ εἰσίν διαιρέσεις ἐνεργημάτων δὲ ὁ αὐτὸς Θεός ὁ ἐνεργῶν τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: kai eisin diaireseis energēmatōn de ho autos Theos ho energōn ta panta en pasin
verses.literal: - There are different ways of working but the same God - works - all things in all [people]

verses.original: δὲ Ἑκάστῳ ἡ φανέρωσις τοῦ Πνεύματος δίδοται πρὸς τὸ συμφέρον
verses.transliteration: de Hekastō hē phanerōsis tou Pneumatos didotai pros to sympheron
verses.literal: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good

verses.original: γὰρ μὲν ᾧ δίδοται διὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος λόγος σοφίας δὲ ἄλλῳ λόγος γνώσεως κατὰ τὸ αὐτὸ Πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: gar men hō didotai dia tou Pneumatos logos sophias de allō logos gnōseōs kata to auto Pneuma
verses.literal: - - To one there is given through the Spirit [the] message of wisdom - to another [the] message of knowledge by the same Spirit

verses.original: ἑτέρῳ πίστις ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ Πνεύματι δὲ ἄλλῳ χαρίσματα ἰαμάτων ἐν τῷ ἑνὶ Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: heterō pistis en tō autō Pneumati de allō charismata iamatōn en tō heni Pneumati
verses.literal: to another faith by the same Spirit - to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit

verses.original: δὲ ἄλλῳ ἐνεργήματα δυνάμεων δὲ ἄλλῳ προφητεία δὲ ἄλλῳ διακρίσεις πνευμάτων ἑτέρῳ γένη γλωσσῶν δὲ ἄλλῳ ἑρμηνεία γλωσσῶν
verses.transliteration: de allō energēmata dynameōn de allō prophēteia de allō diakriseis pneumatōn heterō genē glōssōn de allō hermēneia glōssōn
verses.literal: - to another [the] working of miracles - to another prophecy - to another distinguishing between spirits to another vvv speaking in various tongues and to [still] another [the] interpretation of tongues

verses.original: δὲ πάντα ταῦτα ἐνεργεῖ ἓν καὶ τὸ αὐτὸ τὸ Πνεῦμα διαιροῦν ἑκάστῳ ἰδίᾳ καθὼς βούλεται
verses.transliteration: de panta tauta energei hen kai to auto to Pneuma diairoun hekastō idia kathōs bouletai
verses.literal: - All these are the work of one and the same - Spirit who apportions [them] to each one as He determines

verses.original: γὰρ Καθάπερ τὸ σῶμα ἐστιν ἕν καὶ ἔχει πολλὰ μέλη δὲ τὰ τοῦ σώματος μέλη ὄντα πολλὰ πάντα ἐστιν ἕν σῶμα οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: gar Kathaper to sōma estin hen kai echei polla melē de ta tou sōmatos melē onta polla panta estin hen sōma houtōs kai ho Christos
verses.literal: - - The body is a unit though it is composed of many parts And [although] . . . [its] . . . parts are many they all form one body So [it is] - with Christ

verses.original: γὰρ καὶ ἐν ἑνὶ Πνεύματι ἡμεῖς πάντες ἐβαπτίσθημεν εἰς ἓν σῶμα εἴτε Ἰουδαῖοι εἴτε Ἕλληνες εἴτε δοῦλοι εἴτε ἐλεύθεροι καὶ πάντες ἐποτίσθημεν ἓν Πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: gar kai en heni Pneumati hēmeis pantes ebaptisthēmen eis hen sōma eite Ioudaioi eite Hellēnes eite douloi eite eleutheroi kai pantes epotisthēmen hen Pneuma
verses.literal: For - in one Spirit we vvv were all baptized into one body whether Jews or Greeks - slave or free and vvv we were all given one Spirit {to drink}

verses.original: γὰρ Καὶ τὸ σῶμα ἔστιν οὐκ ἓν μέλος ἀλλὰ πολλά
verses.transliteration: gar Kai to sōma estin ouk hen melos alla polla
verses.literal: For - the body does not consist . . . of one part but of many

verses.original: ἐὰν ὁ πούς εἴπῃ Ὅτι εἰμὶ οὐκ χείρ εἰμὶ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος παρὰ τοῦτο ἔστιν οὐ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος
verses.transliteration: ean ho pous eipē Hoti eimi ouk cheir eimi ouk ek tou sōmatos para touto estin ou ouk ek tou sōmatos
verses.literal: If the foot should say Because I am not a hand I do not belong to the body that . . . would not [ make it any less ] a part of the body

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν τὸ οὖς εἴπῃ Ὅτι εἰμὶ οὐκ ὀφθαλμός εἰμὶ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος παρὰ τοῦτο ἔστιν οὐ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος
verses.transliteration: kai ean to ous eipē Hoti eimi ouk ophthalmos eimi ouk ek tou sōmatos para touto estin ou ouk ek tou sōmatos
verses.literal: And if the ear should say Because I am not an eye I do not belong to the body that . . . would not [ make it any less ] a part of the body

verses.original: εἰ τὸ ὅλον σῶμα ὀφθαλμός ποῦ ἡ ἀκοή εἰ ὅλον ἀκοή ποῦ ἡ ὄσφρησις
verses.transliteration: ei to holon sōma ophthalmos pou hē akoē ei holon akoē pou hē osphrēsis
verses.literal: If the whole body [were] an eye where [would] the sense of hearing [be] If [the] whole [body] [were] an ear where [would] the sense of smell [be]

verses.original: δὲ Νυνὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἔθετο τὰ μέλη ἐν τῷ σώματι ἕκαστον ἓν αὐτῶν καθὼς ἠθέλησεν
verses.transliteration: de Nyni ho Theos etheto ta melē en tō sōmati hekaston hen autōn kathōs ēthelēsen
verses.literal: But in fact - God has arranged the members of the body every one of them according to His design

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ἦν τὰ πάντα ἓν μέλος ποῦ τὸ σῶμα
verses.transliteration: de ei ēn ta panta hen melos pou to sōma
verses.literal: - If they were - all one part where [would] the body [be]

verses.original: δὲ νῦν μὲν πολλὰ μέλη δὲ ἓν σῶμα
verses.transliteration: de nyn men polla melē de hen sōma
verses.literal: - As it is . . . [there are] many parts but one body

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ὀφθαλμὸς Οὐ δύναται εἰπεῖν τῇ χειρί ἔχω οὐκ Χρείαν σου ἢ πάλιν ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῖς ποσίν ἔχω οὐκ Χρείαν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: de ho ophthalmos Ou dynatai eipein tē cheiri echō ouk Chreian sou ē palin hē kephalē tois posin echō ouk Chreian hymōn
verses.literal: - The eye vvv cannot say to the hand I do not need you [Nor can] . . . the head [say] to the feet I do not need you

verses.original: ἀλλὰ πολλῷ μᾶλλον τὰ μέλη τοῦ σώματος δοκοῦντα ὑπάρχειν ἀσθενέστερα ἐστιν ἀναγκαῖά
verses.transliteration: alla pollō mallon ta melē tou sōmatos dokounta hyparchein asthenestera estin anankaia
verses.literal: On the contrary . . . . . . the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable

verses.original: καὶ ἃ τοῦ σώματος δοκοῦμεν εἶναι ἀτιμότερα τούτοις περιτίθεμεν περισσοτέραν τιμὴν καὶ ἡμῶν τὰ ἀσχήμονα ἔχει περισσοτέραν εὐσχημοσύνην
verses.transliteration: kai ha tou sōmatos dokoumen einai atimotera toutois peritithemen perissoteran timēn kai hēmōn ta aschēmona echei perissoteran euschēmosynēn
verses.literal: and the - [parts] we consider . . . less honorable - we treat with greater honor And our - unpresentable [parts] are treated with special modesty

verses.original: δὲ ἡμῶν τὰ εὐσχήμονα ἔχει οὐ χρείαν Ἀλλὰ ὁ θεὸς συνεκέρασεν τὸ σῶμα δοὺς περισσοτέραν τιμήν τῷ ὑστερουμένῳ
verses.transliteration: de hēmōn ta euschēmona echei ou chreian Alla ho theos synekerasen to sōma dous perissoteran timēn tō hysteroumenō
verses.literal: whereas our - presentable [parts] have no [such] need But - God has composed the body [and] has given greater honor to the [parts] that lacked it

verses.original: ἵνα ᾖ μὴ σχίσμα ἐν τῷ σώματι ἀλλὰ τὰ μέλη τὸ αὐτὸ μεριμνῶσιν ὑπὲρ ἀλλήλων
verses.transliteration: hina ē mē schisma en tō sōmati alla ta melē to auto merimnōsin hyper allēlōn
verses.literal: so that there should be no division in the body but that [its] members {should have} mutual concern for one another

verses.original: καὶ εἴτε ἓν μέλος πάσχει πάντα τὰ μέλη συμπάσχει εἴτε ἓν μέλος δοξάζεται πάντα τὰ μέλη συνχαίρει
verses.transliteration: kai eite hen melos paschei panta ta melē sympaschei eite hen melos doxazetai panta ta melē synchairei
verses.literal: - If one part suffers every - part suffers with [it] if one part is honored every - part rejoices with [it]

verses.original: δέ Ὑμεῖς ἐστε σῶμα Χριστοῦ καὶ ἐκ μέρους μέλη
verses.transliteration: de Hymeis este sōma Christou kai ek merous melē
verses.literal: Now you are [the] body of Christ and each of you [is] . . . a member [of it]

verses.original: Καὶ οὓς μὲν ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ὁ Θεὸς ἔθετο πρῶτον ἀποστόλους δεύτερον προφήτας τρίτον διδασκάλους ἔπειτα δυνάμεις ἔπειτα χαρίσματα ἰαμάτων ἀντιλήμψεις κυβερνήσεις γένη γλωσσῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai hous men en tē ekklēsia ho Theos etheto prōton apostolous deuteron prophētas triton didaskalous epeita dynameis epeita charismata iamatōn antilēmpseis kybernēseis genē glōssōn
verses.literal: And - - in the church - God has appointed first of all apostles second prophets third teachers then [workers of] miracles [and] [those with] gifts of healing helping administration [and] various tongues

verses.original: μὴ πάντες ἀπόστολοι μὴ πάντες προφῆται μὴ πάντες διδάσκαλοι μὴ πάντες δυνάμεις
verses.transliteration: mē pantes apostoloi mē pantes prophētai mē pantes didaskaloi mē pantes dynameis
verses.literal: [Are] all apostles [Are] all prophets [Are] all teachers [Do] all [work] miracles

verses.original: μὴ πάντες ἔχουσιν χαρίσματα ἰαμάτων μὴ πάντες λαλοῦσιν γλώσσαις μὴ πάντες διερμηνεύουσιν
verses.transliteration: mē pantes echousin charismata iamatōn mē pantes lalousin glōssais mē pantes diermēneuousin
verses.literal: [Do] all have gifts of healing [Do] all speak in tongues [Do] all interpret

verses.original: δὲ ζηλοῦτε τὰ τὰ μείζονα χαρίσματα Καὶ ἔτι δείκνυμι ὑμῖν καθ’ ὑπερβολὴν ὁδὸν
verses.transliteration: de zēloute ta ta meizona charismata Kai eti deiknymi hymin kath’ hyperbolēn hodon
verses.literal: But eagerly desire the - greater gifts And now I will show you vvv the most excellent way
